get.description:
By id, ``name@version`` or ``name`` (resolution of ADR-0021); the body
carries the full contract v1 when the version has one (ADR-0056). The
legacy ``config`` is returned empty to callers without ``org.read``.

post.description:
Create an invocation; a repeat of ``idempotencyKey`` returns 200 with the
existing one. The call is executed later by a skill executor — poll
``GET /skill-invocations/{id}`` or follow ``skill.invocation_*`` events.

Take one executable pending invocation under a lease; 204 when none.

The response carries what the executor needs to run the call — name,
version, side effects and the full contract with its implementation — so
no second read is needed. The catalog ``config`` is not part of it: it
stays behind ``org.read`` (ADR-0056 amendment). ``settings`` — the
effective settings of the skill's package, ``null`` for a skill not
from a package (CP-ADR-0081 §8). ``invocationId`` narrows the claim to
one call.

Report a result. The core re-validates ``output``: a violation turns
the invocation ``failed`` with ``output_contract_violation`` (still 200 —
the report was accepted, the verdict is in the body). The execution call
of a task also hands in the task's typed outputs (CP-ADR-0072).

Report a failure; a retryable one returns the call to ``pending`` while
attempts remain (``retryPolicy``).

Cancel a ``pending`` or ``running`` call (its authority or ``org.manage``).

A running call's executor loses its lease; it may already have acted —
``error.details.wasRunning`` says so. A finished call is ``409
invocation_terminal``; a cancelled one is returned unchanged.

AcceptanceCheckSpec.title: AcceptanceCheckSpec
AcceptanceCheckSpec.description:
One declared check, executed by the verification stage (CP-ADR-0067).

On a task, ``spec`` follows the grammar of ``kind``: ``deterministic`` —
``{skill: name@version, inputs?, expect?}`` or ``{artifact: {type,
mediaTypes?, content?}}``; ``external_state`` —
``{event?}``; ``human`` — ``{approver? | approverRole?}``; ``llm_judge`` —
as ``human`` plus ``rubric?``. A spec outside it is
``422 invalid_acceptance_spec``. On a goal it is not interpreted.

``when`` — ``$.task`` expressions (CP-ADR-0061 grammar) that must all
resolve to something when the attempt reaches the check; otherwise the
check is ``skipped`` with reason ``condition_unmet``. Not on a goal.

EventPageOut.title: EventPageOut
EventPageOut.description:
Journal page: ``nextCursor`` is always present (echoes the input when
nothing new is stable) so followers can poll without decoding cursors.
``prevCursor`` is the ``before`` of the preceding page; ``null`` on a
backward read (``before``/``tail``) means the start of the journal.

ExternalReferenceRegisterRequest.title: ExternalReferenceRegisterRequest
ExternalReferenceRegisterRequest.description:
Generic registration: the entity is named in the body, not in the path.

``entityId`` is a reference rather than a strict UUID — a task may be named
by its public id, which is what an importer carrying legacy identifiers has
in hand.

HarnessBlock.title: HarnessBlock
HarnessBlock.description: Harness registration announced at session open (control-harness/<n>).

IamIdentitySpec.title: IamIdentitySpec
IamIdentitySpec.description: A federated identity as IAM names it: issuer, IAM tenant, IAM principal.

JournalArchiveRequest.title: JournalArchiveRequest
JournalArchiveRequest.description: Move (or delete) journal history up to a safe horizon.

KnowledgeDocumentLink.title: KnowledgeDocumentLink
KnowledgeDocumentLink.description:
An entity of the knowledge base the document is about: ``{kind, key}``
as a snapshot names it, and the relation from the document to it.

KnowledgeDocumentRequest.title: KnowledgeDocumentRequest
KnowledgeDocumentRequest.description:
A document of the knowledge base (CP-ADR-0060 amendment 2026-09-28):
text already cut into chunks by the caller -- the core parses no files --
stored in the namespace of the workspace tree root, like a snapshot.

KnowledgeEntitiesInclude.title: KnowledgeEntitiesInclude
KnowledgeEntitiesInclude.description:
What to add to every entity of the page (CP-ADR-0060, amendment 2026-10-03).

``relations`` -- the relation names, or ``"*"`` for every relation the
namespace's packs declare; ``direction`` -- the entity as the subject
(``out``), the object (``in``) or either; ``limit`` -- relations per entity.

KnowledgeEntitiesPageOut.title: KnowledgeEntitiesPageOut
KnowledgeEntitiesPageOut.description:
One page in ``(kind, key, namespace)`` order. The list ends only at
``nextCursor: null``: a page may hold fewer than ``limit`` items before it.

KnowledgeEntitiesQueryRequest.title: KnowledgeEntitiesQueryRequest
KnowledgeEntitiesQueryRequest.description:
The entities of ``kinds`` in a workspace's knowledge (CP-ADR-0060, K031).

Every entity of the kinds valid at ``asOf`` (now when omitted) whose
attributes satisfy all ``where`` conditions, ``limit`` per page; ``cursor``
is the ``nextCursor`` of the previous page, the other fields unchanged.
The namespace (the workspace tree root) and the visibility come from
``workspaceId`` and the caller, never from the client.

validFrom.title: Validfrom
validFrom.description: Start of the version valid at asOf.

validTo.title: Validto
validTo.description: End of that version; null -- open.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Every source the entity is merged from, the senior first. Each also carries the transitional scope, snapshot_id and source_path.

relations.title: Relations
relations.description: Only when the request has include.relations.

source.description: The senior source: sources[0].source. Transitional (CP-ADR-0060, amendment 2026-10-03): removed only by a later amendment.

source_path.title: Source Path
source_path.description: The senior citation: sources[0].sourcePath. Transitional (CP-ADR-0060, amendment 2026-10-03): removed only by a later amendment.

snapshot_id.title: Snapshot Id
snapshot_id.description: The senior snapshot: sources[0].snapshotId. Transitional (CP-ADR-0060, amendment 2026-10-03): removed only by a later amendment.

KnowledgeEntityOut.title: KnowledgeEntityOut
KnowledgeEntityOut.description:
An entity of the list: the version valid at ``asOf``, merged from its
sources (CP-ADR-0060, amendment 2026-10-03). ``validFrom``, ``validTo``
and ``sources`` are the contract; the snake_case fields are Memory's
``EntityItem`` as it was passed before, kept for the transition.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: out: the entity is the subject; in: the object.

KnowledgeEntityRelationOut.title: KnowledgeEntityRelationOut
KnowledgeEntityRelationOut.description: A relation of the entity and its other end (``include.relations``).

KnowledgeEntitySourceOut.title: KnowledgeEntitySourceOut
KnowledgeEntitySourceOut.description: A source the entity's version was merged from, the senior first.

KnowledgePackOut.title: KnowledgePackOut
KnowledgePackOut.description:
A registered pack version as Memory gives it (``kinds`` with their
``idPatterns``, ``relations``, ``description``), with ``scope`` (``common``
or ``tenant``) and ``ref``, the pinned reference Memory enables it by
(``name@version`` or ``tenant:name@version``).

version.title: Version
version.description: Pack version: a string or a number.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Absent or common: a shared pack (Memory's default scope). tenant: a pack of the caller's tenant.

KnowledgePackRegisterRequest.title: KnowledgePackRegisterRequest
KnowledgePackRegisterRequest.description:
A domain pack manifest, forwarded to Memory as-is (CP-ADR-0060).

Only ``scope`` is the core's to read: absent -- a shared pack, registered
by platform administrators; ``tenant`` -- a pack of the caller's tenant,
registered under ``knowledge.packs.manage`` (amendment 2026-09-28).
``name`` and ``version`` are checked by the core with ``422 pack_invalid``,
the rest of the manifest by Memory. The owner of a tenant pack is the
core's to name: a ``namespace`` in the manifest is refused.

KnowledgeSnapshotPreviewOut.title: KnowledgeSnapshotPreviewOut
KnowledgeSnapshotPreviewOut.description:
Memory's plan of a reconciliation, returned as-is: what would open,
change and close, and the state it was computed on. Only ``stateToken`` is
the core's to name; the rest is Memory's (MEM-ADR-020).

KnowledgeSnapshotPreviewRequest.title: KnowledgeSnapshotPreviewRequest
KnowledgeSnapshotPreviewRequest.description:
A connector's snapshot of one source (CP-ADR-0060), forwarded as-is.

Namespace and visibility scopes are computed by the core from
``workspaceId``; a client that sends them gets 400 like any unknown field.
Entities and relations are opaque here: Memory validates them against the
pack. Bounds mirror Memory's ``parse_snapshot`` so that an oversized
document is refused here, not after a round trip.

KnowledgeSnapshotRequest.title: KnowledgeSnapshotRequest
KnowledgeSnapshotRequest.description:
A snapshot to apply. ``expectedState`` (CP-ADR-0060 amendment
2026-09-28) applies it only while the knowledge of its source is still in
the state a preview showed: otherwise ``409 snapshot_stale``.

MemoryWhereCondition.title: MemoryWhereCondition
MemoryWhereCondition.description:
One ``recall.where`` condition (``$defs/memoryWhere``, MEM-ADR-020).

The value is a literal the caller already computed: the core evaluates no
CEL here and sends the condition to memory unchanged. The value rules are
memory's (``context/where.parse_where``): ``eq`` a scalar, ``in`` 1..100
scalars, ``prefix`` a dotted code, ``lte``/``gte`` a number or an RFC 3339
date, ``exists`` a bool (true when omitted).

RecallRequest.title: RecallRequest
RecallRequest.description:
Pull from the knowledge graph (``cp_recall``, CP-ADR-0064).

Exactly one of ``anchor`` (an identifier: a key, an alias or text an
``idPattern`` matches) and ``query`` (text to extract identifiers from).
``relations`` are followed from the anchors, each ``depth`` steps in
``direction``, at most ``limit`` new entities per step. The namespaces come
from ``task``/``workspaceId``, never from the client. The pack in the
answer is cut to ``budgetTokens`` (``omitted`` counts the rest).
``where`` filters the nodes by their attributes (all conditions hold);
it goes to memory as it is.
